messages:
ajay: Heads-up: two customers reported charges landing on org instead of their project after auth-proxy rollout. Seems related to missing project claim from token exchange.
sofia: saw it in traces. exchange returns project ~70% of the time on the new path; the rest are projectless and fall back to org.
maria: any quick logs?
ajay: redacted snippet:
```
[auth] exchange: claims={} for sub=svc-222
[routing] billing_project=null fallback=org-77
```
sofia: old proxy used to synthesize `x-origin-project` when exchange lacked project. new gateway assumes exchange always sets it.
kai: we must avoid fabricating identity for auth decisions. If we synthesize, mark it telemetry-only and PII-review.
maria: suggestion: add `effective_project` tag in auth pipeline used strictly for billing/telemetry (never in audit logs). Emit a sampled `auth.fallback` event when we fallback.
sofia: implementation: `effective_project = claims.get('project') or infer_from_token_meta()` then `if not claims.get('project'): sampler.emit('auth.fallback', payload={'project_hint': effective_project})`. Start at 5% sampling.
ajay: metrics: `auth.fallback.count{reason=\"no_project\"}` + sampled stream. Canonicalize project into cohorts for aggregated metrics to avoid high cardinality.
maria: Console UX: show \"likely project\" badge on billing rows when confidence >= 60% and link to a dry-run reconciliation action.
kai: privacy: run legal review before increasing sample. Gate rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% after sign-off.
sofia: add debug toggle `auth.debug_full_attribution` for support (must create audit entries).
ajay: ops plan: canary auth-service with sampler at 5%, monitor fallback metric and billing drift. GH issue + privacy reviewers now.
maria: I'll draft console PR for the badge and reconcile flow (dry-run first).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable, canary 5%. CI: green.
ajay: action items assigned. Ping infra-oncall if billing drift >2%. :thumbsup:
